reasoning:
1. Scope and category: NO_SHOW_CHARGE, driver-filed, no safety/complaint flag, so POL-GEN-08(1) permits an automated ruling. The platform has already refunded the 5.50 fee to the rider (EV-TRIP-04064 fee_refunded 2026-09-27; EV-FARE-04064 payment_status REFUNDED). The driver asks for his fee back. Figures in force come from trip_record.platform_policy (fee_schedule.resolution_rule): free_wait_sec 180, no_show_threshold_sec null, cancellation_fee_sgd 5.50, arrival_marker BUTTON, zone STANDARD -> arrival radius 50 m, accuracy filter 25 m.
2. POL-NS-12 does not apply: the marker is BUTTON (driver-pressed), not GPS_AUTO.
3. POL-NS-05: the 'driver_arrived' event (19:06:00) coincides exactly with a gps fix (0 s, so POL-NS-08(a) clock skew is not engaged) placing the driver 655.8 m from the pin (haversine, R=6371.0088) at 38 km/h. Both triggers fire (>300 m; >=15 km/h). The marker is FALSE and does not start the clock; the clock is recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix under POL-NS-02. The driver admits the early tap, and the rider's complaint about the tap is correct.
4. POL-NS-02: first fix within 50 m with accuracy <=25 m is 19:07:50 (27.4 m, acc 3.6 m), followed by 19:08:00 (4.8 m) and 19:08:10 (8.0 m), so the 3-consecutive test is met and the driver ARRIVED at 19:07:50.
5. Recomputed dwell: 19:07:50 to cancellation 19:13:00 = 310 s; every one of the 32 fixes in that span is inside 50 m (stationary at 0 km/h from 19:08:00, max 11.1 m), sample interval 10 s, no gap. 310 s >= 180 s free_wait_sec, so POL-NS-05(iii) applies, not (i) or (ii): the false marker does not by itself defeat the fee, POL-NS-01 governs with limb (b) read from the recomputed clock, and the false marker is recorded as a referral.
6. POL-NS-01: (a) arrived event present; (b) in geofence at the recomputed clock start 19:07:50; (c) continuous dwell 310 s >= 180 s, threshold null; (d) no boarding (started_at null), terminated by driver with RIDER_NO_SHOW at 19:13:00, after the dwell elapsed at 19:10:50. All four limbs hold.
7. Displacing clauses checked: POL-NS-03 - driver's stationary fixes are inside the 50 m radius, not 50-400 m, so not engaged. POL-NS-04 - limb (a) arguably met by MSG-003 ('where are you'), but limb (b) fails: driver replied 20 s later (MSG-004 19:06:50) and placed an in-app call at 19:09:30 (CALL-04064-001); limb (c) also fails on admissible fixes: all 8 rider_track fixes (accuracy 8.4-14.0 m, all <=25 m) are 1007.8-1246.3 m from the pin, none within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. POL-NS-11 not engaged (rider_track present and runnable). POL-NS-06 - dwell 310 s is not short of 180 s; traffic advisory not needed (EV-ADVIS-04064-01 MISSING, weight 0.0, carries no fact and is relied on by no one). POL-NS-10 - the driver cancelled, not the rider; limbs (a),(b),(f),(g) concern rider cancellation and (d),(e) a completed trip; not engaged.
8. POL-NS-08: (a) no skew (arrival fix 0 s; trace runs to 19:13:30, past cancellation). (b) no gap >120 s, 32 fixes in window, rider_track present. (c) EV-CHAT-04064 IS impaired for policy purposes: MSG-002 missing from the sequence, 5 held vs chat_message_count 6, and a 470 s (>300 s) gap 18:58:40-19:06:30 spanning the 19:06:00 marker. Pre-pass weight 0.6, issue TRUNCATED_LOG. The chat does not carry the deciding fact: arrival and dwell rest on EV-GPS-04064 and EV-TRIP-04064 (both COMPLETE, weight 1.0). The chat is used only to show the driver replied, and that is independently carried by trip_record.in_app_calls (weight 1.0). The missing message precedes arrival and could bear only on POL-NS-03(i) fault allocation or POL-NS-10(f), neither of which is engaged. So the finding survives the discount and the POL-NS-08 closing sentence / POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged. (d) fare line 5.50 = platform_policy 5.50; no gross figure named; reconciles.
9. POL-NS-09: (a) POL-GEN-02(2) cap = min weight of artifacts carrying the deciding fact = 1.0 (gps_trace, trip_record, fare_breakdown); confidence above 0.70. (b) the trip_record arrival vs gps distance conflict is resolved by POL-NS-05, so no unresolved contradiction. (c) disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 + 0 = 0 < 2. (d) anti-farming not tripped; rider no_show_disputes_30d 0 < 3. (e) not engaged (point 8). No escalation.
10. POL-NS-07: no_show_terminations_30d 1 < 4 (and 1/132 = 0.0076 < 0.08), so compensation is paid at 80% of the net fee in force: 5.50 x 0.8 = 4.40. Per POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd = driver_compensation_sgd = 4.40; the fee disposition is that the rider owed it (support's reversal was not supported by the record).
11. POL-GEN-01: driver prior_no_show_flags 1, prior_deviation_flags 1, ratings, cancellation rates, prior disputes, rider prior_no_show_flags 1 - all context only and not used. Only the POL-NS-07 counters (no_show_terminations_30d, completed_trips_30d) and POL-NS-09(c)/(d) counters were read.
12. POL-GEN-02(3) narration: EV-CHAT-04064 weight 0.6 TRUNCATED_LOG and EV-ADVIS-04064-01 weight 0.0 MISSING_ARTIFACT are named; neither carries the deciding fact. POL-GEN-05: monetary effect 4.40 <= execution_threshold_sgd 8.00, so executes automatically on issue subject to POL-GEN-04 appeal. Referral: POL-NS-05(iii) false-arrival event.
doubts: (1) Party-relative mechanics: this is a driver-filed dispute over a fee already refunded to the rider. POL-NS-07/POL-GEN-03 make the ruling DRIVER_COMPENSATION 4.40 (80% of 5.50). A reader who treats the driver's claim as for the whole contested 5.50 could argue FULL_REFUND 5.50 to the filing party; I reject that because POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80% of the net fee and POL-GEN-03 says DRIVER_COMPENSATION is the ruling where the driver is owed money. Whether the rider is re-charged 5.50 to fund it is an execution matter the policy does not spell out for already-reversed fees. (2) The truncated chat (missing MSG-002 in the 470 s pre-arrival gap) - a reader who treats the chat as part of the deciding evidence could invoke POL-NS-08's closing sentence / POL-NS-09(e) and ESCALATE; I think that is wrong because arrival and dwell rest entirely on the 1.0-weight GPS and trip record, and the driver's responsiveness is independently shown by the in-app call. (3) 'First qualifying in-geofence fix': if one demanded the clock start at the third fix of the run (19:08:10), dwell would be 290 s, still >=180 s, so the outcome does not change. (4) The rider's story (fake arrival) is correct about the marker but does not defeat the fee under POL-NS-05(iii); rider_track shows the rider ~1 km away throughout.
